Class 1A playoff preview: Dwight and LeRoy in Opening Round
Dwight and LeRoy play in Class 1A Opening Round games this weekend, and according to our projections, one game will be a blowout.
Dwight and LeRoy play in Class 1A Opening Round games this weekend, and according to our projections, one game will be a blowout.
The top eight seeds in each of the North and South brackets of the 48-team Class 1A field have byes in the Opening Round, and the other 32 teams play Friday and Saturday, Oct. 23-24.
Winners advance to the First Round on Saturday, Oct. 31.
We call a game competitive if our projection has it decided by 10 points or fewer and a blowout if the margin is 21 points or more.
Heyworth, the No. 1 seed in the North bracket, has a bye and plays the winner of No. 16 Galena and No. 17 Orr in the First Round.
Opening Round schedule and predictions
Friday, Oct. 23
- 7 p.m.: North: No. 21 Bureau Valley (3-6) at No. 12 Dwight (6-3) (Dwight 37, Bureau Valley 14)
Saturday, Oct. 24
- 1 p.m.: North: No. 18 Orion (4-5) at No. 15 LeRoy (5-4) (LeRoy 31, Orion 20)
Game Capsules
No. 21 Bureau Valley (3-6) at No. 12 Dwight (6-3)
Bureau Valley travels to Dwight in the Class 1A Opening Round, and the winner plays at No. 5 Annawan-Wethersfield (8-1) in the First Round.
Kickoff is 7 p.m. Friday.
#12 Dwight (6-3)
Dwight (6-3) is the No. 12 seed in the 48-team Class 1A field and hosts No. 21 Bureau Valley in the Opening Round.
Dwight went 6-3 overall and 2-1 in Chicagoland Prairie, scoring 204 points and allowing 186, an average margin of +2.0 a game.
Dwight went 8-4 last season, including 2-1 in playoffs. Dwight has reached the playoffs in four of the last 10 seasons.

No. 18 Orion (4-5) at No. 15 LeRoy (5-4)
Orion travels to LeRoy in the Class 1A Opening Round, and the winner plays at No. 2 Stockton (8-1) in the First Round.
Kickoff is 1 p.m. Saturday.
#15 LeRoy (5-4)
